representation: World-space FEM nodes and rigid geometric-origin samples, orientation xyzw.
initial_velocity: All dynamic actors initially at rest.

endpoint_constraints.equivalent_physical_stiffness: k_i=30*m_i/(0.005^2) N/m; preserve this physical stiffness under internal step changes.
endpoint_constraints.target_motion: Prescribed invisible frames are input boundary conditions, not dynamic rigid bodies. No visible/physical clamp, support geometry or endpoint point masses may be added.
endpoint_constraints.external_reaction: Include the finite endpoint-penalty forces as external forces in conservation reporting.

rules: Preserve every physical mesh, shape, actor, mass, material, initial transform and prescribed control schedule.
Numerical methods and internal step sizes may change; return states on every frozen original vertex.
Only endpoint patches/edges are constrained. No interior pins, gravity, floor, hidden supports or precomputed motion.
Implement dynamics independently; neither a source simulator nor an answer trajectory is supplied.

material_constitutive_law.label_caveat: The public FEM.Cloth model label and docstrings do not select its IPC constitution. The accepted source uses StrainLimitingBaraffWitkinShell, already present in Genesis commit 92e32925 before these July runs.
material_constitutive_law.rest_basis: Rotate each rest triangle normal to +Z by the shortest rotation, then take its XY edge matrix Dm. For these initially flat +Z meshes this is simply Dm=[X1-X0,X2-X0] in XY. Preserve the source material X/Y directions, not an edge-aligned basis.
material_constitutive_law.deformation_gradient: F=[x1-x0,x2-x0] @ inverse(Dm), a 3x2 matrix; u=norm(F[:,0]); v=norm(F[:,1]); s=dot(F[:,0],F[:,1]).
material_constitutive_law.membrane_element_energy: E_triangle=(2*thickness*rest_area)*psi. The source strain-limiting rate is fixed at 100.
material_constitutive_law.thickness_semantics: The supplied thickness=0.001 m is libuipc one-sided thickness/radius; full thickness is 0.002 m. Preserve this source convention despite nominal asset text describing 1 mm.
material_constitutive_law.mass_lumping: For each rest triangle add rho*(2*thickness)*rest_area/3 to each incident vertex. Frozen initial_state.npz contains these actual source-convention masses.
material_constitutive_law.bending_energy: For an interior edge of rest length L, let A=A1+A2 (sum of incident rest triangle areas), hbar=A/(3*L), Vbar=A*thickness. E_edge=kappa*(theta-theta_rest)^2*L/hbar*Vbar. kappa is the authored bending_stiffness. Do not omit Vbar or add an extra thickness^3 factor.
material_constitutive_law.bending_rest_angle: Use the dihedral angle of the frozen mesh, with consistent incident-face winding.

fem_damping_semantics: The source FEM integrator is skipped for IPCCoupler; FEMOptions.damping has no effect on these cloth actors. Preserve contact friction and actual joint damping, and disclose numerical damping rather than adding inactive FEM damping.

contact_material_semantics.thickness_gap: For nonlocal cloth-cloth distance subtract t_i+t_j=0.002 m; for cloth-rigid subtract t_cloth=0.001 m (rigid thickness is zero). The barrier activation offset is d_hat in addition to those physical thicknesses.
contact_material_semantics.adjacency: Exclude topologically local incident primitive pairs from self collision, retaining nonlocal vertex-face and edge-edge surface contact.

controller.sample_timing: Evaluate targets at k*0.005 before original step [(k-1)*0.005,k*0.005], holding through numerical substeps.
phases: keep rotations; approach each end 0.12 m and add frozen asymmetric seed offsets
